mascot: Home Helper Harpreet — a friendly elder sister who loves sorting woollens, sketching houses and folding perfect cupboards

slides.title: Why We Wear Clothes 👕
slides.text: Clothes protect us! They keep us safe from hot sun, cold wind and rain. That is why we wear DIFFERENT clothes in different seasons!
slides.spoken: Clothes protect us from heat, cold and rain.

slides.title: Clothes for Seasons ☀️❄️
slides.text: COTTON clothes keep us COOL in summer — cotton soaks sweat and lets air in. WOOLLEN clothes keep us WARM in winter — wool traps warm air. Right clothes, right season!
slides.spoken: Cotton keeps us cool in summer; wool keeps us warm in winter.

slides.title: A House Keeps Us Safe 🏠
slides.text: A house protects us from sun, rain, wind, insects and wild animals. It is also where our family lives together happily. Home is our safest place!
slides.spoken: A house protects us from weather and keeps the family safe.

slides.title: Houses in Different Places 🏘️
slides.text: Houses change with the place! Big cities have tall FLATS. Villages have HUTS with mud walls. Flood areas like Assam build houses on tall bamboo STILTS. In Kashmir, houseboats float on Dal Lake!
slides.spoken: People build different houses to suit their place and weather.

slides.title: Keep Your Home Happy 🧹
slides.text: A clean home is a happy home! Sweep the floor, put things back, air the rooms and help elders with small chores. Everyone in the family can lend a hand!
slides.spoken: We keep our home clean and tidy together.

challenges.question: Which clothes keep us COOL in summer?
challenges.hint: Think of what you wear on a hot day!
challenges.misconception: Cotton is light and lets air in, so it keeps us cool.

challenges.question: Woollen clothes are best for which season?
challenges.hint: What do you wear when it is very cold?
challenges.misconception: Wool traps warm air, so woollens are best in winter.

challenges.question: What do we wear to stay dry in the rain?
challenges.hint: It stops the raindrops from reaching us!
challenges.misconception: A raincoat keeps the rain off and keeps us dry.

challenges.question: Why do we need a house?
challenges.answer: To stay safe from sun, rain and animals
options: To stay safe from sun, rain and animals
challenges.hint: Think about storms at night — where do you run?
challenges.misconception: A house protects us from weather, insects and animals.

challenges.question: Houses on tall bamboo stilts are built in places with ______.
challenges.hint: Water rises — the house stands on tall legs!
challenges.misconception: Stilt houses keep people safe when flood water rises, as in Assam.

challenges.question: Sort each clothing: summer or winter?
challenges.hint: Cotton cools you; wool warms you.
challenges.misconception: Cotton frocks and shorts are for summer. Woollen caps and socks are for winter.

challenges.question: A houseboat floats in ______.
challenges.hint: It is a BOAT that is also a house!
challenges.misconception: Houseboats like in Kashmir's Dal Lake float on water.

challenges.question: Which home is common in big cities?
challenges.answer: A flat in a tall building
options: A flat in a tall building
challenges.hint: Look up at the skyline of a big city!
challenges.misconception: Big cities have tall buildings with many flats.
